thread:
maria: Thanks everyone who joined the all‑hands incident segment — quick thread to collect links, owners, and next steps so we can close the loop. RCA is up: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/INC-2026-732|RCA: INC-2026-732>.

maria: TL;DR root cause = memory leak in runtime KV cache eviction under high concurrent prefix writes; caused OOMs on a small subset of dedicated clusters. Fix landed in runtime v1.12.3 and was hotfixed to affected pools.

incident-bot: Deploy completed: runtime v1.12.3 -> prod-dedicated-1 at 2026-03-10T14:22Z (duration 6m), rolling restart triggered.

aj: Thanks — can you confirm which customers were impacted and whether we sent CS notifications?

maria: Impacted: three enterprise tenants (IDs redacted), mostly spiky QPS during scheduled data migrations. CS notifications: Hazel and Sales sent interim notes yesterday; final update going out today with RCA link.

leo: For roadmap/ops: do we need any config changes for future migrations? e.g., backpressure or limits on prefix writes?

maria: Good call. Short term: we added a conservative concurrency limiter on prefix-write paths (config flag: runtime.kv.prefix_write_limit=200). Long term: design doc for rate-aware batching (owner: @aj).

hazel: I can coordinate customer-facing language. Draft will include what happened, mitigation, and mitigations we added. ETA EOD today for the final note.

sam: Appreciate the quick triage. Two asks from leadership: 1) a 1‑pager on what checks we wire into pre-deploy to catch this (SRE + runtime). 2) a risk assessment for dedicated pools before end of quarter. Owners?

maria: I'll draft the 1‑pager by Friday. Aj + Eng-runtime to contribute pre-deploy checks (heap/regression tests, smoke under high concurrency).

aj: I'll own the pre-deploy checklist items. Plan: add a stress test to CI that simulates heavy prefix writes and an automated OOM detector that fails the build if mem growth > threshold. Targeting PR by next Wed.

maria: Action items consolidated: 
```
- RCA published (link above) — maria (done)
- Hotfix deployed to affected pools — eng-runtime (done)
- Customer final note — hazel (ETA: EOD today)
- Pre-deploy concurrency/stress tests + OOM detector — aj (ETA: next Wed)
- Rate-aware batching design doc — aj (ETA: 2 weeks)
- Add conservative prefix_write_limit config to defaults — maria (done in v1.12.3)
- Postmortem review with CS/Support — leo + hazel (schedule next Mon)
```

leo: One more Q from product — are there any perf regressions from the patch?

maria: No measurable regressions on p50/p95 for normal workloads. We did see slightly higher tail latencies under extreme synthetic workloads; tracking that in the dashboard. Link: <https://dash.redwood.com/d/ops/runtime-kv|runtime-kv dashboard>.

hazel: I'll attach the customer note draft here later and ping for approval.

aj: Quick note on rollout: for Dedicated we recommend a canary to 10% of pools for 48h, then 50% for 24h before full rollout. I'll add rollout steps to the PR description.

sam: Great — prioritize the pre-deploy tests and customer comms. If we get the tests in place, this should be much less likely to recur.

maria: Thanks all. I'll close the loop here after the 1‑pager and hazel's note. If anyone needs to add owners, reply here. :white_check_mark:

leo: Thanks — adding calendar invite for postmortem review (Mon 11am PT).

hazel: Posting customer note draft in #customer-success in 30m for review.

aj: PR opened for stress tests (WIP) — will tag eng-runtime reviewers.

incident-bot: Action items synced to ops-board: https://kanban.redwood.com/board/INC-2026-732
